content.title: Masters cut line tracker 2026: DeChambeau, Spaun, MacIntyre headline list to miss the weekend | Sporting News Canada
content.text: Augusta National can never be categorized as easy place to play, but wind and a firm course made it particularly difficult in Thursday's first round. After two days of play at Augusta, cuts have been made, and some big names have had their weekends cut short.Most notably, Bryson DeChambeau's bunker troubles led him out of contention for his first green jacket. The two-time U.S. Open winner could not get out of his own way in the sand, leading to a 6-over finish through two rounds. Last year's U.S. Open winner, J.J. Spaun, also had his weekend ended on Friday with a 5-over score, along with two-time Masters winner Bubba Watson. This year's Arnold Palmer Invitational winner, Akshay Bhatia, will also be going home after two days of play at Augusta, finishing with a 6-over total score. While Rasmus Hojgaard was able to birdie on hole No. 18 to keep his weekend alive just above the cut line, his identical twin, Nicolai, also finished at 6-over to conclude his weekend.Here's a look at the set cut line at the Masters and which players fell short of the weekend.SN's MASTERS HQ: Live Masters leaderboard | Masters TV coverage | Live streamingWhat is the Masters cut line in 2026?Cut line: +4Players inside cut line: 54The cut line for the Masters in 2026 settled at 4-over par. The cut line in 2025 was 2-over par, but it was as high as 6-over par in 2024.The Masters takes the top 50 golfers plus ties into the weekend, and there are currently 55 players in line to make it to the weekend. The cut line started Friday at +2 and has moved throughout the day.Here are some of the biggest names below the cut line as of Friday evening:Notable players in danger of missing Masters cutThe following players are among those below the cut line at the moment:J.J. Spaun (+5)Bubba Watson (+5)Danny Willett (+5)Nicolai Hojgaard (+6)Bryson DeChambeau (+6)Akshay Bhatia (+6)Zach Johnson (+6)Cameron Smith (+7)Robert MacIntyre (+7)Fred Couples (+9)Min Woo Lee (+11)Nico Echavarria (+13)MORE MASTERS 2026:Ranking the 30 best golfers in this year's MastersOdds, betting favorites, expert picks for the 2026 MastersComplete list of golfers playing in the MastersMasters Tournament cut rulesOnly the top 50 players (plus ties) make the cut at the Masters. This rule was put into effect during the 2020 Masters to keep the weekend field small during the COVID-19 pandemic.Before the rule change, any player within 10 strokes of the leader after 36 holes advanced to the weekend. This was in addition to the top-50 players in the field (plus ties), so it made for a larger field advancing to the weekend. The rule change established that the Masters cut is the most difficult among golf's four majors. The top 60 players make the cut at the U.S. Open, and the top 70 golfers do so at the PGA Championship and the Open Championship.MORE MASTERS NEWS:Complete list of Masters winners by yearWhy Augusta National always hosts the MastersWho has won the most Masters of all time?History behind the famous Masters green jacketInside Augusta's iconic Amen's CornerHow many players make the cut at the Masters?91 golfers teed off on Thursday in Augusta, four fewer, but many won't make it to the weekend.
